_readme: Single source for project, writing, playground and 'currently' content. Edit here, then run `npm run content`. Only verified facts; see CASE-STUDY-FACT-CHECK.md.

person.name: Maria Showalter
person.line: I design and build software, interactive tools, and digital experiments.
person.study: Computer Science, Barnard College of Columbia University

projects.name: FrameFlow
projects.medium: macOS app · Electron · React · Swift (ScreenCaptureKit) · WebCodecs

media.alt: FrameFlow studio: a recording plays with its automatic camera Moments, Moment 02 is renamed and zoomed in, the style changes to Midnight, and an MP4 export finishes

projects.detail: Turns a raw macOS screen recording into a composed product film: clicks and pauses become editable camera Moments, and one renderer drives preview, MP4 and GIF.
projects.line: Record your screen. Edit the camera movement. Export a finished video.

projects.name: Hinge
projects.medium: Web app · React · TypeScript · closed-form spring solver · code generation

media.alt: Hinge: a card is dragged and released, the release spring is retuned to low damping, and the same throw now oscillates home

projects.detail: Tune hover, press and drag by handling a component and shaping its spring, then export a React component that moves exactly the way it did on the stage.
projects.line: Design how interfaces move, then export the code.

projects.name: Edition
projects.medium: Web app · TypeScript · image processing · Web Workers
projects.status: Live · runs entirely in the browser · MIT

media.alt: Edition: a film photograph becomes a cobalt and vermilion halftone print; the plates are lifted apart, one is pushed out of register, and the loupe reads the dots

projects.detail: A photograph becomes a two-ink print: editable halftone plates set at their own angles, overprinted on paper and deliberately out of register, exported at full resolution.
projects.line: Turn photographs into two-color halftone prints.

projects.name: Orbit
projects.medium: Web app · Web Audio (PannerNode, OfflineAudioContext) · TypeScript

media.alt: Orbit: three sounds are added, two paths are drawn around the listener, and playback moves the sounds along them

projects.detail: Choreograph sounds around a listener on a top-down stage. Positions drive real HRTF panning, and the arrangement renders to a WAV that pans the way playback did.
projects.line: Draw paths for sounds to move around your head.

projects.name: Filo
projects.medium: Mobile app (prototype) · React Native / Expo · Supabase (Postgres, RLS) · Mapbox

media.alt: Filo on an iPhone simulator: the campus map with ranked places, the Discover feed, and the ranking screen asking where a new place lands
media.note: Development build in the iOS simulator, sample data.

projects.detail: A campus map of places ranked by people you trust: rank by comparison in about log₂(n) taps and find your taste twins. Prototype; privacy rules are designed into the database but some read policies are still broader than intended.
projects.line: A social map for saving and ranking places.

otherWork.name: TONUS
otherWork.statement: Polyphonic web synthesizer: FM, AM, additive and subtractive synthesis crossfaded in real time, with a chord generator, scope and recorder.

otherWork.name: Global Plastics Recycling Dashboard
otherWork.statement: AI automation pipeline that keeps a recycling-facility dashboard current from press releases and live feeds; presented at ACC's 2025 Geneva conference.
otherWork.medium: Python · n8n · Excel · American Chemistry Council, summer 2025

otherWork.name: Filo recommendation engine
otherWork.statement: Semantic search over a synthetic NYC venue catalogue with a MiniLM model fine-tuned by contrastive loss; not connected to the app.

otherWork.name: REINFORCE from scratch
otherWork.statement: REINFORCE policy gradient written by hand in PyTorch, with no RL libraries; it learns to balance CartPole-v1.

otherWork.name: Inverted pendulum PID
otherWork.statement: Cart-pole physics and a PID controller written from scratch, with a dashboard for tuning Kp, Ki and Kd while it runs.

otherWork.name: Stencil
otherWork.statement: Team hackathon project, 1st place at the NYU EEG Hackathon: a handle becomes a full brand identity, assets and a printable guide.

otherWork.name: Sheet Music to Strudel
otherWork.statement: Sheet music, MusicXML and MIDI to live-coded Strudel patterns through a staged pipeline with validation.

otherWork.name: SafeScan
otherWork.statement: Team of four: QR and URL scanner combining Google Safe Browsing with an 11-rule heuristic engine for typosquatting and phishing.
